title: Connection Setup Configuration
description: Configuration for automated azdw connection initialization

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g., '1.0'). Used for migration between schema versions.

description.description: A human-readable description of this configuration

includesSecrets.description: Whether this configuration contains sensitive data

connections.description: List of Azure DevOps connections to configure

url.description: Azure DevOps organization/project URL, or GitHub/GitHub Enterprise organization URL (e.g. https://github.com/contoso or https://github.contoso.com/contoso)

provider.description: Backing provider for this connection. When omitted it is derived from the URL host (github.com -> GitHub, *.ghe.com or other GitHub hosts -> GitHubEnterprise, otherwise Azure DevOps Services or TFS based on cloud/on-prem).

organization.description: Organization/owner scope for the connection (GitHub org or user; Azure DevOps organization). When omitted it is derived from the URL.

repos.description: Optional repository filter (GitHub). When omitted, all accessible repositories in the organization are in scope. Entries may be plain repo names or owner/repo.

projectStatusRef.description: Optional GitHub Projects v2 reference (project number or name) used to opt in to project Status as the work item state source.

validityDays.description: Number of days the PAT should remain valid

tenantId.description: Optional Azure AD tenant ID for OAuth authentication

queryTypes.description: Work item types to query for validation

queryLimit.description: Maximum number of items to query during validation
